name: synthetic
description: A note in the shape Hyperlit's own vault export writes (MarkdownVaultBuilder): footnote definitions after a rule, one of them multi-paragraph with a quotation; Obsidian block ids closing each reference; and the three ways an in-text citation is exported — a block link, a link to the cited work's note, a DOI link — the last two carrying the reference as the link title. Re-importing it must give the book back: definitions become footnotes and leave the body, the quotation is stored once, block ids are not printed, and every citation links its reference again.
